shadowSentences: I love reading books before bedtime.
The weather is perfect for a picnic today.
My favorite meal is homemade spaghetti and meatballs.
Traveling to new places helps me learn about cultures.
I often listen to music while studying for exams.
Baking cookies with my family is always a fun activity.
Exploring different cuisines is one of my passions.
Playing sports keeps me active and healthy every week.
I enjoy volunteering at the local animal shelter on weekends.
Learning a new language opens many doors for communication.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel experiences.
questions: Q1: Can you share a memorable travel experience you've had?
Q2: What challenges do you often face when traveling?
Q3: How do you feel travel impacts your perspective on life?
Q4: What advice would you give to someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about eco-friendly living.
questions: Q1: What steps do you take to live a more eco-friendly lifestyle?
Q2: What are some common challenges people face in going green?
Q3: Why do you think eco-consciousness is important today?
Q4: What tips would you offer to someone wanting to reduce their carbon footprint?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about appreciating art.
questions: Q1: Can you describe an artwork that has deeply moved you?
Q2: What difficulties do individuals encounter in understanding art?
Q3: How do you think art influences society and culture?
Q4: What suggestions would you give to someone new to appreciating art?
